connect.description: Configuration settings for the Connect service.

urlBase.description: Deprecated: use apiAddress, mtlsServerName, and xdsServerName instead. urlBase will be removed in a future release. Used to construct default endpoint hostnames/SNIs when the explicit values are not set.

apiAddress.description: Address (hostname, optionally with a port) for the TLS API endpoint. Defaults to connect.<urlBase>. Also used as the OAuth audience and oauth-protected-resource 'resource' value, so this is the real address clients use, not just a TLS SNI.

apiServername.description: TLS SNI for the JWT API endpoint. Defaults to apiAddress with any port stripped. Only used for Envoy's filter_chain_match.

apiExtraEndpoints.description: Additional endpoints Envoy will accept for the TLS API, alongside apiAddress/apiServername.

address.description: Address (hostname, optionally with a port) for this additional JWT API endpoint. Used for the OAuth audience, oauth-protected-resource 'resource' value, and :authority/Host matching.

servername.description: TLS SNI Envoy matches for this endpoint. Defaults to address with any port stripped. Only used for Envoy's filter_chain_match.

mtlsServerName.description: TLS SNI for the SPIFFE mTLS endpoint. Defaults to connect-agent.<urlBase>. Only used for Envoy's filter_chain_match.

mtlsExtraServerNames.description: Additional SNIs Envoy will accept for the SPIFFE mTLS endpoint, alongside mtlsServerName.

xdsServerName.description: TLS SNI for the XDS/ADS endpoint. Defaults to xds.<urlBase>. Only used for Envoy's filter_chain_match.

xdsExtraServerNames.description: Additional SNIs Envoy will accept for the XDS/ADS endpoint, alongside xdsServerName.

allowedOrigins.description: List of allowed origins for cross-origin requests.

insecureServerAddress.description: Address for the insecure Connect server endpoint.

adsServerAddress.description: Address for the ADS server endpoint.

trustBundleStoreBackend.description: Configuration of the trust bundle store backend to use. Only one backend may be enabled.

s3.description: Configuration for S3 trust bundle store backend.

enabled.description: True to enable the S3 backend.

bucket.description: Name of bucket to use as trust bundle store.

usePathStyle.description: Determines if path-style addressing is used to access S3 buckets (if false, virtual-hosted-style is used).

encryption.description: Configuration for server-side encryption of objects written to the S3 trust bundle store.

type.description: Server-side encryption mode for objects written to S3: "" (bucket default), "SSE-S3", or "SSE-KMS".

kmsKeyId.description: KMS key to use when type is "SSE-KMS", as a key ID, key ARN, alias name, or alias ARN. Empty uses the account's default KMS key.

oidc.description: Configuration to use OIDC to access S3, exchanging the Connect server's SVID for AWS credentials.

enabled.description: True to use OIDC with the server's SVID to get temporary credentials to access S3 using OIDC, otherwise the AWS credentials will be sourced from the environment.

awsRegion.description: Region to set in the AWS config when obtaining credentials through OIDC.

iamRoleARN.description: ARN of AWS role to assume when obtaining credentials through OIDC.

audience.description: Audience expected by the OIDC provider in AWS.

gcs.description: Configuration for GCS trust bundle store backend.

enabled.description: True to enable the GCS backend.

bucket.description: Name of bucket to use as trust bundle store.

oidc.description: Configuration to use OIDC to access GCS, exchanging the Connect server's SVID for GCP credentials.

enabled.description: True to use OIDC with the server's SVID to get temporary credentials to access GCS using OIDC, otherwise the GCP credentials will be sourced from the environment.

workloadIdentityProvider.description: Fully qualified identifier of GCP workload identity provider to use when obtaining credentials through OIDC. Must be in the form projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_POOL_NAME/providers/WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_NAME.

audience.description: Audience expected by the OIDC provider in GCP.

datastore.description: Configuration of the datastore used by Connect

enabled.description: True to enable SQL connection string datastore connection

connectionString.description: Connection string for the SQL database.

remoteSPIFFEID.description: SPIFFE ID for the remote SQL server.

enabled.description: True to enable Google CloudSQL as the datastore

pscEnabled.description: Whether to use Private Service Connect to connect to the CloudSQL instance

oidc.description: Configuration to use OIDC to access Google CloudSQL

workloadIdentityProvider.description: Fully qualified identifier of GCP workload identity provider.

audience.description: Audience expected by the OIDC provider in GCP

serviceAccountName.description: Name of service account with access privileges to the Connect database

enabled.description: True to enable AWS RDS as the datastore

dbUser.description: Database user to connect as (must have the rds_iam role granted)

oidc.description: Configuration to use OIDC to access AWS RDS, exchanging the server's SVID for temporary IAM credentials

awsRegion.description: AWS region of the RDS instance

iamRoleARN.description: IAM role ARN to assume for database access

audience.description: Audience expected by the OIDC provider in AWS

maxOpenConns.description: Maximum number of open connections in the pool per Connect instance.

connMaxLifetime.description: Maximum time a connection may be reused (Go duration string, e.g. "5m", "1h").

connMaxIdleTime.description: Maximum time a connection may be idle before being closed (Go duration string, e.g. "1m").

connectPSATAudience.description: Audience value to expect when using PSATs for Cofide SPIRE.

trustDomain.description: The trust domain of the Connect trust zone.

connectTrustBundleStoreURL.description: URL for the Connect trust bundle store.

authzPolicyEngine.description: The authorization policy engine to use.

initialRBAC.description: Initial RBAC configuration to bootstrap the system.

version.description: Version of the initial RBAC configuration (bump this to trigger RBAC bootstrap on next restart, version 0 means it will be ignored).

roleID.description: ID of the role to bind

resourceType.description: Type of resource to bind to

resourceID.description: ID of resource to bind to

subject.description: JWT subject value to match for binding

claimValue.description: Value in JWT groups claim to match for binding

audit.description: Configures audit event recording and the sinks events are sent to.

enabledEvents.description: List of event types to enable. Use "all" to enable every event type.

disabledEvents.description: List of event types to disable. Subtracted from the resolved enabledEvents list.

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the connect api binary.

value.description: Simple string value to be set as environment variable

valueFrom.description: Source of environment value as defined in https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#envvarsource-v1-core

externalTrafficPolicy.description: Controls how traffic is routed from external load balancers. Set to Local to preserve the original client source IP.

proxyProtocol.description: PROXY protocol configuration for the Envoy listener.

enabled.description: Enable PROXY protocol on the Envoy listener. Requires the upstream load balancer to send PROXY protocol headers.
